neighbours.label: Tokens in weather-forecasting text that anticipate a meteorological agency or upper-air term (forecasters at the National [Weather Service], 500 mb, Bureau of [Meteorology]), vs the same institutional frames in non-weather contexts
fire: A meteorologist at the National Weather Service said the cold front would arrive Friday.
Satellite images show the storm strengthening, the National Hurricane Center reported.
On the latest charts, 500 mb heights are falling over the northern plains.
Forecasters with the Bureau of Meteorology warned of severe thunderstorms in Queensland.
The National Weather Service in Denver issued a winter storm watch for the foothills.
Radar loops from the Weather Service showed heavy snow bands moving east.
Strong jet stream winds at 250 mb will steer the low toward the coast.
Pilots should check the aviation weather forecast before crossing the mountains.
quiet: A ranger at the National Park Service said the canyon road would reopen Friday.
Sales figures show the company strengthening, the national business press reported.
On the latest charts, mortgage rates are falling across the northern states.
Officials with the Bureau of Statistics published new wage figures for Queensland.
The National Archives in Denver opened a new exhibit on the gold rush.
Photos from the zoo showed the baby panda moving between enclosures.
Strong sales of electric cars will push the company toward the coast.
Pilots should check the airline staff schedule before crossing the terminal.

predictions: Forecast sentences naming a weather service or pressure level 0.3-0.65; matched agency frames outside weather (Park Service, Bureau of Statistics) under 0.2.
notes: Card: ' National' x5 before 'Weather Service', ' Aviation' Weather, ' Australian' Bureau of Meteorology, '200 mb'. Probe: 'Forecasters at the National Weather Service' 0.643 on ' National', '200 mb winds' 0.443, 'Bureau of Meteorology' 0.306; 'National Park Service' 0.175, 'Bureau of Statistics' 0.200, 'Upper-level management' 0.082. The pole fires on ' National' before it sees 'Weather', so the forecasting context is the trigger.
